verdict.rationale: Weave mentions webhook automations triggered by alerts, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Weave's versioning of traced functions and ops covers application code, not automations, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
